newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra cuts pork production this week.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra cuts pork production this week.

text.p: ConAgra Inc said Wednesday it was reducing pork production at its four plants this week, which is similar to action taken by IBP Inc and Excel Corp, a division of Cargill Inc.
"We are making some severe industry cutbacks," said ConAgra spokeswoman K.T. Miller.
The cutbacks are for this week only, she said.
ConAgra did not give a reason for the reduction, but industry sources said this week a recent sharp drop in cash pork prices has forced the cutbacks at pork companies.
Miller said the reductions are at ConAgra's pork subsidiary, Swift and Co., which operates three hog slaughter and pork production plants and one pork production plant.
Earlier this week IBP announced it was operating is seven hog and pork plants at less than 40 hours a week. Excel Corp said it continues to operate its pork plants "at a reduced mode."
